description: This file contains functions for transforming and splitting PyTorch FX graph modules related to autocast nodes, including replacing autocast nodes with HOP (Higher-Order Programming) subgraphs, and splitting autocast regions into submodules.

methods.name: _is_autocast_node
methods.description: Checks if a node is an autocast call function node (enter or exit).

methods.name: _is_enter_autocast_node
methods.description: Checks if a node is an autocast enter function node.

methods.name: _is_exit_autocast_node
methods.description: Checks if a node is an autocast exit function node.

methods.name: _is_autocast_sub_mod
methods.description: Determines if a node is an autocast submodule based on its first non-placeholder node.

methods.name: _check_valid_autocast_block
methods.description: Validates that the autocast enter and exit nodes form a proper block.

methods.name: _replace_with_hop
methods.description: Replaces a node with a HOP subgraph if it contains autocast nodes.

methods.name: _split_autocast
methods.description: Splits a graph module into submodules based on autocast regions.

methods.name: _sequential_split_and_maybe_inline_subgraphs
methods.description: Splits the graph into subgraphs and inlines or replaces them with HOP subgraphs.

methods.name: replace_autocast_with_hop_pass
methods.description: Main function to split and transform autocast regions into HOP subgraphs within a graph module.
